# RequestHandlerAttribute

Kind: Class  
Namespace: `Sisk.Core.Routing`  
Assembly: `Sisk.Core.dll`  
Source: https://docs.sisk-framework.org/api/Sisk.Core.Routing.RequestHandlerAttribute.html

Specifies that the method or class, when used on this attribute, will instantiate the type and call the [IRequestHandler](https://docs.sisk-framework.org/api/Sisk.Core.Routing.IRequestHandler.md) with given parameters.

```csharp
[AttributeUsage(AttributeTargets.Class|AttributeTargets.Method, AllowMultiple = true)]
public class RequestHandlerAttribute : Attribute
```
